impact: Higher-for-longer rates weigh on long-duration holdings (NBIS, PLTR, BE) and support bank net interest income (C).
summary: Odds of a hike at the Dec 8-9 FOMC rose to about 85% after the October jobs report. UBS expects 25bp hikes in December and March. Waller still entertains further hikes; the 10-year yield is around 4.85%.
title: December Fed hike odds near 85% after hot jobs data
